starting-the-quest.player: Hello Arianwyn. What are we going to do about the Temple of Light?

starting-the-quest.speaker: Arianwyn
starting-the-quest.text: First of all, we need to know how close the Iorwerth elves are to finding it. Return to the Mourner Headquarters and gain access to their mine. Once there, see what you can discover about the temple.

starting-the-quest.prompt: Start the Mourning's End Part II quest?

steps.player: I'll head over there right away.

steps.speaker: Arianwyn
steps.text: Thank you friend. Don't forget your disguise.

steps.player: I don't have time to do that right now.

steps.speaker: Arianwyn
steps.text: Well don't take too long. Every second we waste is a big risk.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-arianwyn-a.player: What do I need to do again?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-arianwyn-a.speaker: Arianwyn
starting-the-quest-talking-to-arianwyn-a.text: Return to the Mourner Headquarters and gain access to their mine. Once there, see what you can discover about the Temple of Light.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-arianwyn-a.speaker: Arianwyn
starting-the-quest-talking-to-arianwyn-a.text: Thank you friend. Don't forget your disguise.

talking-to-essylt.player: Do you have the key to the excavation site yet?

talking-to-essylt.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Essylt
steps.text: Try freeing up some space in your inventory, then we can talk about keys.

talking-to-essylt.speaker: Essylt
talking-to-essylt.text: The guard has finally returned. Seems it took him so long because he had ten times more cut than we needed.

talking-to-essylt.player: That's useful. I'm always losing keys.
So... You mentioned a task you had for me, something to do with the mines?

talking-to-essylt.speaker: Essylt
talking-to-essylt.text: That's right. One of our dig teams has gone missing while searching for the temple. I need you to find out what happened to them.

talking-to-essylt.speaker: Essylt
talking-to-essylt.text: You say that now but the beasts in the mines are deadly, you'll have to be very careful in there.
Essylt hands you a newly cut key.

talking-to-essylt-talking-to-essylt-agai.speaker: Essylt
talking-to-essylt-talking-to-essylt-agai.text: Any news yet on our missing dig team?
If the player lost the mine key:

steps.player: I've lost the key to the mine.

steps.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Essylt
steps.text: Free up some inventory space and get another one from my desk.

steps.speaker: Essylt
steps.text: Have a new one then, if you lose it help yourself to one from my desk.
Essylt hands you a newly cut key.

reaching-the-temple.text: Player approaches the temple entrance and sees the lifeless bodies of the dig team

reaching-the-temple.player: Well this looks like the dig team, and it seems they managed to find the temple. I'd better let Arianwyn know before the Mourners find out.

steps.text: You find a colour wheel and some notes but you don't have enough room to take them.
You find a colour wheel and some notes.

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.speaker: Essylt
reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.text: Any news yet on our missing dig team?

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.player: No, I have looked everywhere but I can't see any sign of them.

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.speaker: Essylt
reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.text: This is not good news. Did you find anything else down there?

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.player: Nothing other than the beasts you spoke of.

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.speaker: Essylt
reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.text: I must ask you to return to the search. Do let me know if you see anything elven-made down there as well. Any clues to the location of the temple will be very helpful.

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.player: I'll let you know as soon as I find something.

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.text: If the player lost the mine key:

steps.player: I've lost the key to the mine.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-being-given-.player: Good, I have been given access to the mine beneath West Ardougne. I can now begin searching it.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-being-given-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-being-given-.text: Very good, let me know when you discover something.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: [player name], what is the latest news?

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: I think I have found the entrance to the temple. It looks like one of the dig crews discovered it. They were killed by some strange shadows though, so the other mourners don't know about it yet.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: This isn't good, it will only be a matter of time before they discover the temple.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: I did some research while you were gone. Apparently, the temple was built with safeguards to prevent all but Seren's chosen from entering.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: If there are shadows roaming outside the temple, it means those safeguards have long since decayed. I believe we can still restore them though.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: The temple guards an ancient altar, one with powers over life and death. I suspect this altar is why Lord Iorwerth is so keen to access the temple.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: You think he means to use it to summon the Dark Lord?

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Indeed. Now, the altar is also key to the safeguards on the temple. We will need to use it to restore them.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: First, I need you to return to the temple and find the crystal that is powering the safeguards. As they are no long working, I expect the crystal will be black in colour.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Bring me a sample of this crystal. We will then determine our next steps.
If the player doesn't have the black crystal:

steps.player: So go to the temple, find a black crystal and bring you a sample of it. Got it. I'll be back soon.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: You show the blackened crystal to Arianwyn.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Yes! Good work.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: Thanks, I found it on the top floor of the temple.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Well done, with this sample, a good crystal chanter should be able to make a replacement. Just a second, I will summon Eluned.
Eluned appears next to Arianwyn

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Thank you for responding to my summons Eluned.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Eluned
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Any time Arianwyn, how can I help?

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: [player name] here has an old crystal sample, we need you to make a replacement for it.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Eluned
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Alright, hand it here and I shall take a look.
You hand Eluned the blackened crystal.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Eluned
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Now, let me see... Hmm... Ah, there we go.
Eluned gives you a newly formed crystal.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Eluned
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: No problem, Arianwyn will tell you what you should do with it. Now I had better get going, see you round.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: I have the new crystal, now what am I meant to do with it?

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: You will need to first take the newly formed crystal to the end of the temple and place it on the altar there. This will imbue the crystal with the power it needs to safeguard the temple.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: This is starting to sound hard.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: It should be quite simple. Once you have powered up the newly formed crystal, you will need to return to the blackened crystal and place the new shard with others. This should restore the safeguards.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Yes, that is all.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: Right then, I'll get to it.

returning-to-arianwyn-talking-to-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-talking-to-arianwy.text: [player name], do you have that sample yet?
If the player has the black crystal:

steps.player: Is this it?

returning-to-arianwyn-talking-to-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-talking-to-arianwy.text: Don't take too long. Remember, you need to search the temple for a blackened crystal. Once you find it, bring a sample of it back here.

the-temple-of-light-searching-the-pillar.text: There is a green crystal fused into the pillar.

the-temple-of-light-fractured-crystal-pl.text: The crystal only fits the pillar with the clear side facing north.
The crystal only fits the pillar with the clear side facing east.

the-temple-of-light-fractured-crystal-ta.text: You take the fractured crystal from the pillar.

the-temple-of-light-fractured-crystal-in.text: This fractured crystal doesn't seem to fit right in this pillar.

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: Player steps through the light barrier after solving the puzzle and is met with a dwarf standing next to the Death Altar

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.player: Funny, I was just going to ask you the same thing.
Well I battled my way through hordes of shadows, whilst trying to solve a huge maze that I had to bounce a light beam around. Now your turn.

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.speaker: Thorgel
the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: I came in through this hole in the back.

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.player: You mean there's an easy way?

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.speaker: Thorgel
the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: Not easy as such. A few of the boys and me set up an outpost at the other end of the tunnel, at the bottom of a huge cavern. The only way to get there is through caves riddled with traps.

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.player: Hang on, this sounds familiar. Is the name of one of your companions Klank?

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.speaker: Thorgel
the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: Yes, how did you know that?

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.player: He's a friend of mine, he made me a great pair of gauntlets.
That's right. How did you know that?

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.speaker: Thorgel
the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: Klank told me about you, told me how you got rid of that Iban fellow. As it's you, I'll make you an offer, I'll trade you a Death Talisman. You'll need it if you want to access this altar.
If the player has a death talisman in their inventory:

steps.player: Thanks, but I have one.

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Well if you wanna ‘nother, just come back and I'll tell you what I need.

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: If the player does not have a death talisman:

steps.player: Great... Wait, what for?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: I just need a few things, here I'll make you a list.
The Dwarf writes on a scrap of paper and hands it to you.

steps.player: Right I'd better get started, see you soon.

the-temple-of-light-retrieving-items-for.speaker: Thorgel
the-temple-of-light-retrieving-items-for.text: Hi again, how're you doing with those items we need?

options.text: I've got some of them with me.

steps.player: I've got some of them with me.

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Great, can I take everything I need?
If the player still has items to turn in:

steps.player: Yeah sure.

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Thanks, I've updated your list for you.
After the player has turned in all the items:

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Great, thank you so much for getting all that for us! Here take this Death Talisman as a reward. Anytime you want another one of those Talismans come see me and I'll sort you out with another list.

steps.player: I'd rather you didn't.

options.text: Do you have another copy of the list?

steps.player: Do you have another copy of the list?

steps.text: If the player already has the list:

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: You already have the list! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.
If the player doesn't have the list:

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Try not to lose it this time, we need everything on it! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.
If the player doesn't have the list and their inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Looks like you're carrying enough stuff at the moment.

options.text: What do you need all this stuff for?

steps.player: What do you need all this stuff for?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Oh well, we don't get many deliveries down here, so it's supplies mostly...

options.text: What about the Agility arena ticket?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: What about the Agility arena ticket?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Well you see.. Umm... We don't really get much chance to.. Er.. Go out or anything... And we'd like some of the prizes some day...

steps.player: So why didn't you ask for the prizes then?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Oh no, that'd just be sad.

options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: What about the Archery ticket?

options.text: So why do you want the Crumbling tome?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: So why do you want the Crumbling tome?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Oh just some light reading, it's nice to catch up on current events occasionally.

steps.player: Current events? But it's... Oh never mind.

options.text: So why do you want the Battered book?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: So why do you want the Battered book?

options.text: So why do you want Prifddinas' history?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: So why do you want Prifddinas' history?

options.text: How do you explain the Dusty key?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: How do you explain the Dusty key?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Ah... Um... I'm not sure how that got on the list... Can we have it anyway?

steps.player: Right, why do I get the feeling I shouldn't?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Pretty please with a Blood Talisman on top?!

steps.player: A Blood Talisman?!

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Oops! I meant 'Death Talisman'!

options.text: How do you explain the Jail key?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: How do you explain the Jail key?

options.text: How do you explain the Door key?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: How do you explain the Door key?

options.text: Yeah right, all of those are just 'supplies'.

steps.player: Yeah right, all of those are just 'supplies'.

options.text: No, I'd better get looking for them.

steps.player: No, I'd better get looking for them.

the-temple-of-light-charging-the-newly-m.text: You place the crystal on the altar. It starts to glow with a strange light.

the-temple-of-light-resealing-the-temple.text: You place the powered crystal amongst the other shards.

informing-arianwyn.player: Good news Arianwyn, I've repaired the safeguards on the Temple of Light.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: This is good news indeed, [player name]. That should stop anyone from entering for another thousand years.

informing-arianwyn.player: Erm... not quite. It seems some dwarves have managed to tunnel through to the back of the temple.
Yes. They've set up an outpost in the Underground Pass.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: This is interesting news. I will send an envoy down to speak with them. We must ensure all access into the temple is secure.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: Even still, I can't see Lord Iorwerth discovering this tunnel any time soon. For now, he should have no way to summon the Dark Lord.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: This isn't the end by any means. The Iorwerth forces are still at large and we are not strong enough to stop them. However, with the temple secure, the main threat has been dealt with.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: I will let you know if there are any further developments. For now though, your work is done.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: I can't offer much of a reward I'm afraid. However, I did have Eluned make this for you. It should allow you to bypass the defences on the temple.
